audit.whatIsWrong: win[6] reads Pantheon while whys[6] says 'At 2+ items her Silver Bolts true damage and Condemn stun out-scale you decisively — this window is hers' and the late paragraph opens 'This is her game and you know it'.
audit.why: Three separate strings in the entry hand the two-item stage to Vayne, and the packet's levelChart for this pairing also gives her that row. Pantheon winning it is not supported by anything in the file.
audit.corrected: content win[6] moved from Pantheon to Vayne.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is the axis of the whole matchup and its cooldown appears nowhere.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s at 550 range. Twenty seconds at rank 1 is an enormous window and it is the difference between 'bait her Condemn' as a vague instruction and a countable one. Tumble is 6s at rank 1 and Final Hour 100s.
audit.corrected: Condemn's 20s written into early, whys[3], whys[5], breakdown.cooldowns and report[5]; Final Hour's 100s and Tumble's 6s into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'before Tumble invis or Condemn can answer' at levels 2-3, and 'Use Q Tumble invis and move speed to dodge your W-leap'. Tumble does not grant invisibility.
audit.why: Riot: Tumble is a roll that empowers her next attack — an auto-attack reset. The invisibility comes from Final Hour, her ultimate, which enhances Tumble. Telling a Pantheon that a level-2 Vayne can vanish out of his engage is telling him to fear something that cannot happen until 6, and it hides the thing that IS true at 2: the Tumble reset is her burst tell.
audit.corrected: Tumble described as an auto reset; the invisibility attributed to Final Hour at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says Condemn cancels Aegis Assault, and the entry advises using the block while closing the gap.
audit.why: Condemn is a knockback and Aegis Assault is a channel — the displacement ends it. Since Condemn is also the ability she saves for your engage, holding the shield through the gap-close is holding it into the one thing that removes it. The _missing-interactions file flags this pairing for exactly this.
audit.corrected: Written into wants.you[1], mid, late and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright'; also 'Silver Bolt autos' where the ability is Silver Bolts.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will. Silver Bolts is the plural name and it is an every-third-hit effect rather than something riding every auto.
audit.corrected: phases[0].why and breakdown.early rewritten; Silver Bolts named correctly in wants.you[1] and mid.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours and you must cash them in hard, because this lane only gets worse. Bait or dodge her Condemn (she'll try to pin you to a wall on your engage), then leap on, stun, and empowered-Q burst. Do NOT let her free-farm; every CS she takes safely is a step toward the lane she actually wins.

notes: Two things worth knowing that the entry got wrong. First, 'before Tumble invis or Condemn can answer' and 'Use Q Tumble invis to dodge your W-leap' — Tumble does not grant invisibility at any rank. It is a roll that empowers her next attack; the stealth comes from Final Hour enhancing it at 6. The page therefore makes a level-2 Vayne sound like she can vanish out of the engage, and simultaneously omits what Tumble actually is: an auto-attack reset, which is the burst tell _missing-interactions flags for this pairing. Second, Condemn's cooldown was never stated anywhere despite the entire lane plan being 'bait her Condemn'. It is 20 seconds at rank 1 — one of the longest windows Pantheon gets against any top laner. Added the interaction that matters most: Condemn is a knockback, Aegis Assault is a channel, and she saves the knockback for exactly the moment you commit — so the shield must not be running through your gap-close. CHART: moved win[6] to Vayne, which three strings in the entry and the packet chart all support. Packet suspectName 'Silver Bolt' was a real find — the ability is Silver Bolts, corrected in wants.you[1].
